A '''factory''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. Like all factories on Bellassa, it had both research and manufacturing facilities in the same compound.<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> the factory's caretaker, [[Russell Wake]], allowed the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] to sneak into the factory to determine what it was producing.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
